response.sql: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipment_reference, AVG(se.humepct) AS average_humidity FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry GROUP BY e.equipregistry), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS all_equipment_average FROM equipment_avg), above_average AS (SELECT ea.* FROM equipment_avg ea CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ea.average_humidity > o.all_equipment_average), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(average_humidity) AS above_group_average FROM above_average) SELECT a.equipment_reference, a.average_humidity, a.average_humidity - o.all_equipment_average AS above_all_equipment_average, a.average_humidity - g.above_group_average AS difference_from_group_mean FROM above_average a CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN group_avg g WHERE o.all_equipment_average IS NOT NULL AND g.above_group_average IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
